transcript.en: Hello English learners and welcome to EnglishPod.
transcript.zh: 大家好，英语学习者们，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

transcript.en: My name is Marco.
And I'm Erica.
Erica, today we are really excited, right?
transcript.zh: 艾瑞卡，今天我们真的很兴奋，对吧？

transcript.en: Yeah, we've got a great lesson today, all about real English.
transcript.zh: 是的，我们今天有一节很棒的课，全是关于地道英语的。

transcript.en: Exactly, English that you hear in movies and TV shows.
transcript.zh: 没错，就是你在电影和电视节目中听到的英语。

transcript.en: Yeah, speaking of movies, today's podcast takes place at the movies.
transcript.zh: 是啊，说到电影，今天的播客就发生在电影院里。

transcript.en: Exactly, and that's why it's so fun today.
transcript.zh: 没错，所以今天才这么有趣。

transcript.en: Uh-huh.
And so before we listen to our dialogue, let's take a look at our vocabulary preview.
transcript.zh: 在听对话之前，我们先来看词汇预览。

transcript.en: Vocabulary preview.
In today's vocabulary preview, we have two words.
transcript.zh: 今天的词汇预览有两个词。

transcript.en: And the first word is inconsiderate.
Inconsiderate.
Inconsiderate.
So, Erica, what is it when someone is inconsiderate?
transcript.zh: 那么艾瑞卡，当某人是 inconsiderate（不体谅他人的）是什么意思？

transcript.en: If someone's inconsiderate, they're not thinking about the feelings of other people.
transcript.zh: 如果某人不体谅他人，他们就不考虑别人的感受。

transcript.en: Right.
For example, yesterday, I was on the subway and it was full.
transcript.zh: 比如，昨天我坐地铁，地铁上很满。

transcript.en: Right.
And an old lady was standing there and no one got up to give her their seat.
transcript.zh: 一位老太太站在那里，没有人站起来给她让座。

transcript.en: That was pretty inconsiderate.
Great.
So now let's take a look at our second word and it's keep it down.
transcript.zh: 那么现在我们来看第二个词，keep it down（小声点）。

transcript.en: Keep it down.
Keep it down.
Keep it down.
So, why don't we listen to some examples on how we use keep it down so we can understand.
transcript.zh: 那么，我们先听几个关于 keep it down 用法的例子，这样我们就能理解了。

transcript.en: Example one.
Excuse me.
Do you mind keeping it down?
It's after midnight.
Okay.
Sorry.
Example two.
I'm trying to study.
Do you mind keeping it down?
Example three.
You mind keeping it down?
I'm trying to watch the game.
So that means be quiet.
Yes.
Don't make so much noise.
I used to hear this one all the time from my mother.
transcript.zh: 我以前老是从我妈那里听到这句话。

transcript.en: I think we all did when we were children.
transcript.zh: 我想我们小时候都听过。

transcript.en: Yeah.
Okay.
So now let's listen to the dialogue for the first time.
transcript.zh: 现在我们来听第一遍对话。

transcript.en: It's going to be kind of fast.
But don't worry about it if you can't understand everything.
transcript.zh: 但如果不能全部听懂也别担心。

transcript.en: By the end of today's lesson, you will understand this dialogue.
transcript.zh: 在今天课程结束时，你会完全理解这段对话。

transcript.en: Those people in front of us are making so much noise.
It's so inconsiderate!
transcript.zh: 真是太不为别人着想了！

transcript.en: Don't worry about it, it's not such a big deal.
transcript.zh: 别在意，没什么大不了的。

transcript.en: Oh... I can't hear a thing!
Excuse me, can you keep it down?
Sure, sorry about that!
Someones phone is ringing!
Honey, I think its your phone.
Did you forget to switch it off?
Oh, no!
You are right.
That's so embarrassing!
Do you mind keeping it down?
I'm trying to watch a movie here!
I hate it when people's phones ring when I'm watching a movie.
transcript.zh: 我讨厌看电影时有人手机响。

transcript.en: I think everyone gets kind of angry, but we're going to talk about this a little bit later.
transcript.zh: 我想每个人都会有点生气，不过我们稍后会聊这个。

transcript.en: Why don't we take a look now at our language takeaway?
transcript.zh: 现在我们来看看语言要点吧？

transcript.en: Language takeaway.
So the language takeaway is our most important words for today's lesson.
transcript.zh: 语言要点是我们今天课程最重要的词汇。

transcript.en: And our first word today is not such a big deal.
transcript.zh: 我们今天的第一个词是 not such a big deal。

transcript.en: Not such a big deal.
Not such a big deal.
So when something is not a big deal, it's not a big problem.
transcript.zh: 当某事 not a big deal 时，就不是什么大问题。

transcript.en: It's not important, right?
Exactly.
Okay, let's listen to some examples.
transcript.zh: 好的，我们来听几个例子。

transcript.en: Example one.
I can't get these files due by tomorrow.
transcript.zh: 我无法在明天之前完成这些文件。

transcript.en: It's okay.
It's not such a big deal.
Example two.
I'm really sorry.
I'm going to be 10 minutes late for the meeting.
It's not such a big deal.
Peter and Liam are late too.
transcript.zh: 彼得和利亚姆也迟到了。

transcript.en: Now let's look at our second word and it's switch it off.
transcript.zh: 现在我们来看第二个词，switch it off（关掉它）。

transcript.en: Switch it off.
Switch it off.
Switch it off.
So this word means to turn it off.
transcript.zh: 所以这个词意思是关掉它。

transcript.en: To turn something off.
Now we can use it in three different ways.
transcript.zh: 现在我们可以用三种不同的方式使用它。

transcript.en: Yeah, this one is a little bit complicated because it changes a little bit depending on how you use it.
transcript.zh: 是的，这个有点复杂，因为它会根据用法稍微变化。

transcript.en: So Marco, I think you've got some examples for us.
transcript.zh: 那么马可，我想你有一些例子给我们。

transcript.en: Right.
So for example, I can say, did you switch off your phone?
transcript.zh: 例如，我可以说，你关掉手机了吗？

transcript.en: Or you could say, did you switch your phone off?
transcript.zh: 或者你可以说，你把手机关了吗？

transcript.en: Right.
Or simply you can ask, did you switch it off?
transcript.zh: 或者你可以简单地问，你关掉它了吗？

transcript.en: I think this one is a little bit hard.
Let's look at a couple more examples.
Okay.
So I can say, for example, switch off the TV.
Switch the TV off.
Or switch it off.
Yeah.
I think that's a little bit more clear.
Yeah.
But you know what?
We even had trouble with that one, didn't we?
transcript.zh: 我们刚才也遇到那个问题了，对吧？

transcript.en: Yeah.
We had to do it a couple of times.
transcript.zh: 我们不得不录了好几遍。

transcript.en: Okay.
Now let's look at our last word and it's can't hear a thing.
transcript.zh: 现在我们来看最后一个词，can not hear a thing。

transcript.en: Can't hear a thing.
I can't hear a thing.
Can't hear a thing.
Okay.
We have some examples for this phrase, so let's listen.
transcript.zh: 我们有一些关于这个短语的例子，来听听。

transcript.en: Example one.
What's going on in there?
I don't know.
I can't hear a thing.
Example two.
What?
I'm sorry.
This music is too loud.
I can't hear a thing.
So that's like saying, I can't hear.
transcript.zh: 所以这就像在说，我听不见。

transcript.en: Exactly.
I can't hear anything.
It's too loud.
Right.
So now we are ready to listen to our dialogue a second time.
transcript.zh: 现在我们准备听第二遍对话了。

transcript.en: It's going to be slower.
This time listen for some of the key words we were explaining.
transcript.zh: 这次注意听我们解释过的关键词。

transcript.en: Those people in front of us are making so much noise.
It's so inconsiderate!
transcript.zh: 真是太不为别人着想了！

transcript.en: Don't worry about it, it's not such a big deal.
transcript.zh: 别在意，没什么大不了的。

transcript.en: Oh... I can't hear a thing!
Excuse me, can you keep it down?
Sure, sorry about that!
Someones phone is ringing!
Honey, I think its your phone.
Did you forget to switch it off?
Oh, no!
You are right.
That's so embarrassing!
Do you mind keeping it down?
I'm trying to watch a movie here!
Okay, great.
Now with the dialogue slower, it's really understandable.
transcript.zh: 对话放慢之后，就很容易理解了。

transcript.en: Yeah, I think you could catch those key words a lot better.
transcript.zh: 是的，我想你能更好地捕捉到那些关键词了。

transcript.en: Perfect.
So now we are ready to look at putting it together.
transcript.zh: 那么现在我们准备看「融会贯通」了。

transcript.en: Putting it together.
So in putting it together, we help you use a great phrase in different ways.
transcript.zh: 在融会贯通中，我们帮你以不同的方式使用一个很棒的短语。

transcript.en: And today's phrase is, do you mind?
transcript.zh: 今天的短语是，do you mind?（你介意吗？）

transcript.en: Do you mind?
Do you mind?
Okay, so let's listen to some examples on how you can use this phrase in different situations.
transcript.zh: 好的，我们来听一些例子，看看如何在不同场景中使用这个短语。

transcript.en: Example one.
Do you mind holding my coat for me?
transcript.zh: 你介意帮我拿一下外套吗？

transcript.en: Example two.
Oh, I forgot my wallet.
Do you mind paying for dinner?
transcript.zh: 你介意帮我付晚餐钱吗？

transcript.en: Example three.
Do you mind turning off your phone?
transcript.zh: 你介意关掉你的手机吗？

transcript.en: So this phrase is usually pretty polite.
transcript.zh: 所以这个短语通常相当礼貌。

transcript.en: I could say to you, Marco, do you mind holding my coat for me?
transcript.zh: 我可以说，马可，你介意帮我拿一下外套吗？

transcript.en: And that's really polite.
Yeah.
So would you mind, do you mind are very polite phrases.
transcript.zh: 所以 would you mind, do you mind 是非常礼貌的短语。

transcript.en: But depending on your voice and how you use your tone, it could be a little bit sarcastic, right?
transcript.zh: 但取决于你的声音和语气，可能会有点不一样。

transcript.en: Yeah, it could be a little bit rude if you say, would you mind keeping it down?
transcript.zh: 如果你用某种语气说 would you mind keeping it down，可能会有点粗鲁。

transcript.en: Exactly.
Like we heard in our dialogue.
transcript.zh: 就像我们在对话中听到的那样。

transcript.en: Yeah.
So that's not so polite.
Yeah, exactly.
I mean, in English, you have to be careful because your tone of voice tells the other person how you're feeling.
transcript.zh: 我是说，在英语中你得小心，因为你的语气会告诉对方你是什么情绪。

transcript.en: If you're angry, sad, or just like in any other language.
transcript.zh: 不管是生气、难过，就跟其他任何语言一样。

transcript.en: Yeah, that's true.
So I mean, using a phrase like, do you mind is a great phrase, but make sure you keep a positive tone in your voice.
transcript.zh: 所以 do you mind 是一个很棒的短语，但要确保你用对了语气。

transcript.en: Exactly.
So now that we've talked about all these great things, we can listen to the dialogue a third time, but it'll be at its normal speed.
transcript.zh: 既然我们已经聊了这么多精彩的内容，现在可以听最后一遍对话了。

transcript.en: Those people in front of us are making so much noise.
It's so inconsiderate!
transcript.zh: 真是太不为别人着想了！

transcript.en: Don't worry about it, it's not such a big deal.
transcript.zh: 别在意，没什么大不了的。

transcript.en: Oh... I can't hear a thing!
Excuse me, can you keep it down?
Sure, sorry about that!
Someones phone is ringing!
Honey, I think its your phone.
Did you forget to switch it off?
Oh, no!
You are right.
That's so embarrassing!
Do you mind keeping it down?
I'm trying to watch a movie here!
So I know that in different countries, there are different habits about watching movies.
transcript.zh: 所以我知道在不同国家，看电影有不同的习惯。

transcript.en: Yeah, that's definitely true.
Erica, what's it like in Canada?
transcript.zh: 艾瑞卡，加拿大是什么情况？

transcript.en: Well in Canada, it's really common to eat popcorn and candy and maybe chips while you're watching a movie.
transcript.zh: 嗯在加拿大，看电影时吃爆米花、糖果、也许还有薯片是很常见的。

transcript.en: But, if your phone rings in the movie theater, this is a big problem.
transcript.zh: 但是，如果你的手机在电影院里响了，这可是个大问题。

transcript.en: I imagine it is.
I mean, I would be upset also.
transcript.zh: 我是说，我也会不高兴的。

transcript.en: What about in Ecuador?
Well, in Ecuador and in South America, usually people can bring in food from the outside.
transcript.zh: 嗯，在厄瓜多尔和南美洲，通常人们可以从外面带食物进来。

transcript.en: Really?
Yeah, so it's not really uncommon, depending on the city, to find people bringing in chicken or some sort of like really smelly food.
transcript.zh: 是啊，根据城市不同，看到有人带炸鸡或某种很臭的食物进来并不罕见。

transcript.en: No way!
So, you get either really hungry or really upset, but that's what happens.
transcript.zh: 所以，你要么变得很饿，要么变得很不爽，但这就是那里的情况。

transcript.en: You know, I used to live in Switzerland, and in Switzerland you would have to eat before you watch the movie.
transcript.zh: 你知道，我以前住在瑞士，在瑞士你得在进电影院之前就把饭吃了。

transcript.en: There was no popcorn, no soda, no candy inside the movie theater.
transcript.zh: 电影院里没有爆米花、没有汽水、没有糖果。

transcript.en: Can you imagine that?
I could not live with that because the whole purpose of going to the movies is to have some popcorn and relax and have a good time.
transcript.zh: 我受不了那样，因为去看电影的全部意义就是吃爆米花、放松、享受时光。

transcript.en: You can't have a movie without popcorn.
transcript.zh: 你不能没有爆米花看电影。

transcript.en: Exactly.
Okay, so we've talked a lot about how to ask someone to be quiet today, and I hope that you'll go out and try a few of these phrases in your daily life.
transcript.zh: 好了，今天我们聊了很多关于如何请别人安静的内容，希望大家回去以后也在日常生活中试试这几个短语。

transcript.en: Yes, and I hope also that you visit our website at EnglishPod.com and leave all your questions and comments.
transcript.zh: 是的，我也希望你们访问我们的网站 EnglishPod.com，留下你们所有的问题和评论。

transcript.en: Marco and I are there every day, so we'll be happy to answer your questions, but until next time, bye!
transcript.zh: 马可和我每天都在那里，所以我们很乐意回答你们的问题，但下次见，再见！

transcript.en: Bye!
